sections.text: "Panda" is a hip hop and trap song. The hook was written about a white BMW X6, a luxury SUV which he likens to the appearance of a panda bear. The black X6 is compared to a phantom. "I'm just putting it in a greater way of how I say and the way I live." Desiigner discovered the song's beat on YouTube, which was produced by up-and-coming Rochdale-based producer Menace. Menace has stated the track takes influence from the UK grime scene.

sections.heading: Critical reception
sections.wikitext: ''[[Rolling Stone]]'' named "Panda" one of the 30 best songs of the first half of 2016, writing "The [[Future (rapper)|Future]]-esque rapping and menacing [[Trap music|trap]] beat that underlies 'Panda'{{'}}s ridiculous repetition were already making Internet waves, but a prominent sample on Kanye West's ''The Life of Pablo'' made Desiigner a fixture everywhere from car stereos to ''[[Vogue (magazine)|Vogue]]'' shoots."<ref>{{cite magazine|url=https://www.rollingstone.com/music/pictures/30-best-songs-of-2016-so-far-20160622|title=30 Best Songs of 2016 So Far|magazine=Rolling Stone|date=June 23, 2016|access-date=June 23, 2016}}</ref> ''[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]'' ranked "Panda" at number 24 on their "100 Best Pop Songs of 2016" list: "Visions of a black-and-white BMW X6 sparked Desiigner's breakout joyride anthem 'Panda'. The [[Brooklyn]] upstart's spazzy, high-octane bars may have required a [[Genius.com]] lyric video to decipher, but the energy was so contagious that Kanye West had to tap the melodic G.O.O.D. Music MC's smash for his own [[zeitgeist]]-capturing album."<ref>{{cite magazine|url=http://www.billboard.com/articles/events/year-in-music-2016/7617635/billboard-top-100-pop-songs-of-2016|title=Billboard's 100 Best Pop Songs of 2016: Critics' Picks|magazine=Billboard|access-date=December 12, 2016|date=December 12, 2016}}</ref> ''[[Pitchfork (website)|Pitchfork]]'' listed "Panda" on their ranking of the 100 best songs of 2016 at number 56.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://pitchfork.com/features/lists-and-guides/9981-the-100-best-songs-of-2016/?page=10|title=The 100 Best Songs of 2016|publisher=Pitchfork Media|date=December 12, 2016|access-date=December 12, 2016}}</ref>

sections.heading: Commercial performance
sections.wikitext:

The feat ended a record-setting 41-week streak of non-Americans topping the chart. It stayed at number one for two weeks, until it was replaced by "[[One Dance]]" by Drake featuring [[Wizkid (musician)|Wizkid]] and [[Kyla (British singer)|Kyla]] on the chart issue dated May 21, 2016.<ref name="billboard">{{cite magazine | url=https://www.billboard.com/pro/desiigner-panda-billboard-hot-100-number-1/ | title=Desiigner's 'Panda' Claws to No. 1 on Hot 100, Bringing Americans Back to the Top | magazine=Billboard | date=April 25, 2016 | access-date=April 25, 2016 | author=Trust, Gary}}</ref> Desiigner was the first rapper to crown the Hot 100 with a debut chart entry since [[Iggy Azalea]] arrived with "[[Fancy (Iggy Azalea song)|Fancy]]" (featuring [[Charli XCX]]), which ruled for seven weeks beginning June 7, 2014.

At 18 years and 11 months old, Desiigner was the youngest artist to top the Hot 100 since [[Lorde]], who was 16 years and 11 months old when "[[Royals (Lorde song)|Royals]]" assumed the top spot (for nine weeks) on October 12, 2013.<ref name="billboard"/> The song spent seventeen weeks in the top ten of the Hot 100 before dropping out. It also reached number one on [[Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs]]. Among the Hot 100's component charts, "Panda" peaked at number 2 on [[Digital Songs]] and 10 on [[Hot 100 Airplay (Radio Songs)|Radio Songs]], and topped [[Streaming Songs]].<ref>{{cite magazine|url=http://www.billboard.com/artist/6897402/desiigner/chart|title=Desiigner - Chart history - Billboard|magazine=[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]}}</ref><ref name="US temp">{{cite magazine|url=https://www.billboard.com/pro/desiigner-panda-billboard-hot-100-number-1/|title=Desiigner's 'Panda' Claws to No. 1 on Hot 100, Bringing Americans Back to the Top|magazine=[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]|access-date=April 19, 2016}}</ref> As of December 2016, it has sold 1,524,000 copies in the United States.<ref name="sales">{{Cite news |url=https://www.yahoo.com/music/15-best-selling-singles-2016-slideshow-wp-023312395/photo-p-song-sold-1-763-photo-023312401.html |title=The Best-Selling Singles of 2016 |date=December 19, 2016 |access-date=December 19, 2016 |work=Yahoo! Music |archive-date=July 3, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170703180329/https://www.yahoo.com/music/15-best-selling-singles-2016-slideshow-wp-023312395/photo-p-song-sold-1-763-photo-023312401.html |url-status=dead }}</ref> The song had the most on demand streams (audio and video combined) in the US in 2016 (791,000).<ref>{{cite web |title=Nielsen Music Year-End Report U.S. 2016 |url=https://www.nielsen.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2019/04/2016-year-end-music-report-us.pdf |website=Nielsen |access-date=10 January 2020 |archive-date=22 September 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210922051848/https://www.nielsen.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2019/04/2016-year-end-music-report-us.pdf |url-status=dead }}</ref>
sections.text:
"Panda" debuted at number 96 on the US Billboard Hot 100 for the chart issue dated March 12, 2016, and reached the top five in its seventh week. On its ninth week, "Panda" reached number one on the Hot 100 for the chart dated May 7, 2016, ending the nine-week reign of "Work" by Rihanna featuring Drake. The feat ended a record-setting 41-week streak of non-Americans topping the chart. It stayed at number one for two weeks, until it was replaced by "One Dance" by Drake featuring Wizkid and Kyla on the chart issue dated May 21, 2016. Desiigner was the first rapper to crown the Hot 100 with a debut chart entry since Iggy Azalea arrived with "Fancy" (featuring Charli XCX), which ruled for seven weeks beginning June 7, 2014.

At 18 years and 11 months old, Desiigner was the youngest artist to top the Hot 100 since Lorde, who was 16 years and 11 months old when "Royals" assumed the top spot (for nine weeks) on October 12, 2013. The song spent seventeen weeks in the top ten of the Hot 100 before dropping out. It also reached number one on Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs. Among the Hot 100's component charts, "Panda" peaked at number 2 on Digital Songs and 10 on Radio Songs, and topped Streaming Songs. As of December 2016, it has sold 1,524,000 copies in the United States. The song had the most on demand streams (audio and video combined) in the US in 2016 (791,000).

sections.heading: Remixes, samples and media usage
sections.wikitext:
"Panda" has been unofficially [[remix]]ed several times by various rappers, including [[T-Pain]], [[Lil Mama]], [[Uncle Murda]], [[Montana of 300]], [[Dave East]], [[Lupe Fiasco]], [[Futuristic (rapper)|Futuristic]], [[Meek Mill]], [[Lil' Kim]], [[Cupcakke]], [[Maino (rapper)|Maino]], [[Kash Doll]], [[Fabolous]], [[Joyner Lucas]] and [[Fat Trel]] among others.<ref name="xxl">{{cite web|url=http://www.xxlmag.com/news/2016/04/desiigner-panda-remixes/|title=8 "Panda" Remixes You Need to Hear|work=[[XXL (magazine)|XXL]]|date=April 6, 2016|access-date=April 13, 2016}}</ref><ref name="fader">{{cite web|url=http://www.thefader.com/2016/04/21/desiigner-panda-tpain-remix/|title=T-Pain Hopped On Desiigner's "Panda"|work=[[The Fader|Fader]]|date=April 21, 2016|access-date=April 21, 2016}}</ref>

A Spanish version was released by Cuban [[Latin trap]] artist [[Almighty (rapper)|Almighty]] on the Miami-based label Carbon Fiber Music.<ref>{{cite magazine|url=https://www.billboard.com/pro/desiigner-panda-almighty-chart-debut/|title=Spanish Version of Desiigner's 'Panda' by Puerto Rican Rapper Almighty Debuts on Hot Latin Songs|magazine=[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]|date=April 29, 2016}}
</ref> Borrowing the original version's beat, it features [[Farruko]], owner of said label, while a subsequent remix adds [[Daddy Yankee]] and [[Cosculluela]].<ref name="xxl"/> Additionally, fellow Latin trap artist [[Anuel AA]] released a [[diss track]] towards Almighty, entitled "RIP Panda" and using the same beat, after being taken down from the remix.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m1wSsq0Fcv0|title=Almighty - Al Grano Con El Guru (2da entrevista)|website=[[YouTube]]|date=12 December 2016 }}</ref>

Kanye West sampled the song for his song "Pt. 2" which appeared on his seventh studio album, ''The Life of Pablo'' (2016). In an interview with [[Big Boy (radio host)|Big Boy]] on June 3, 2016, Kanye West announced an official "15 minute" Panda remix, featuring verses from all GOOD Music artists.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.hotnewhiphop.com/44677-there-will-apparently-be-a-panda-remix-featuring-every-good-music-artist-news|title=There Will Apparently Be A "Panda" Remix Featuring Every G.O.O.D. Music Artist|work=HotNewHipHop|date=June 3, 2016|access-date=June 3, 2016}}</ref> However, as of 2026, the remix has not seen any release.

"Panda" was used by [[National Basketball Association|NBA]] player [[Shaquille O'Neal]] as his [[WrestleMania 32]] [[Music in professional wrestling|entrance music]].<ref>{{cite web | url=http://hiphopdx.com/videos/id.22821/title.shaquille-oneal-walks-out-to-desiigners-panda-at-wrestlemania-32 | title=Shaquille O'Neal Walks Out To Desiigner's "Panda" At Wrestlemania 32 | work=HipHopDX | date=April 4, 2016 | access-date=April 18, 2016}}</ref>

The song is also heard in the television shows ''[[Empire (2015 TV series)|Empire]]'', ''[[Rosewood (TV series)|Rosewood]]'', ''[[Black-ish]]'', ''[[Son of Zorn]],'' ''[[Skam (TV series)|Skam]]'',<ref>{{cite web|title=Skam|website=[[IMDb]]|date=2015-09-25|url=https://www.imdb.com/title/tt5934500/?ref_=ttep_ep1|access-date=October 15, 2016}}</ref> and ''[[The Last Man on Earth (TV series)|The Last Man on Earth]].''

The song is also heard in the films ''[[The Secret Life of Pets 2]]'' (in which [[Kevin Hart]] briefly covers the track) and ''[[Baywatch (film)|Baywatch]].''

[[Beyoncé]] used the song as part of a dance break during her song "[[Diva (Beyoncé song)|Diva]]" in [[The Formation World Tour]].
sections.text:
"Panda" has been unofficially remixed several times by various rappers, including T-Pain, Lil Mama, Uncle Murda, Montana of 300, Dave East, Lupe Fiasco, Futuristic, Meek Mill, Lil' Kim, Cupcakke, Maino, Kash Doll, Fabolous, Joyner Lucas and Fat Trel among others.

A Spanish version was released by Cuban Latin trap artist Almighty on the Miami-based label Carbon Fiber Music. Borrowing the original version's beat, it features Farruko, owner of said label, while a subsequent remix adds Daddy Yankee and Cosculluela. Additionally, fellow Latin trap artist Anuel AA released a diss track towards Almighty, entitled "RIP Panda" and using the same beat, after being taken down from the remix.

Kanye West sampled the song for his song "Pt. 2" which appeared on his seventh studio album, The Life of Pablo (2016). In an interview with Big Boy on June 3, 2016, Kanye West announced an official "15 minute" Panda remix, featuring verses from all GOOD Music artists. However, as of 2026, the remix has not seen any release.

"Panda" was used by NBA player Shaquille O'Neal as his WrestleMania 32 entrance music.

The song is also heard in the television shows Empire, Rosewood, Black-ish, Son of Zorn, Skam, and The Last Man on Earth.

The song is also heard in the films The Secret Life of Pets 2 (in which Kevin Hart briefly covers the track) and Baywatch.

Beyoncé used the song as part of a dance break during her song "Diva" in The Formation World Tour.

sections.heading: Music video
sections.wikitext: The song's official [[music video]] was released on May 10, 2016, through the subscription-based digital music streaming platform [[Tidal (service)|Tidal]]. The YouTube video came out on May 17 and has over half of a billion views as of 2023. The night time music video features an urban theme and close-ups of Desiigner himself, with a [[cameo appearance]] by Kanye West.<ref name="Video">{{cite web|url=http://pigeonsandplanes.com/2016/05/desiigner-panda-video/|date=May 11, 2016| website=[[Pigeons and Planes]]|access-date=May 11, 2016|title=THE VIDEO FOR DESIIGNER's "PANDA" IS FINALLY HERE}}</ref> Desiigner carjacks a stopped black [[BMW X6]] and cruises the streets; he then rides shotgun as he raps with Ye driving. At the end, he watches a white X6 [[doing donuts]].
